Package com.github.workerframework.core

Class WorkerApplication

java.lang.Object
io.dropwizard.core.Application<WorkerConfiguration>
com.github.workerframework.core.WorkerApplication
public final class WorkerApplication extends io.dropwizard.core.Application<WorkerConfiguration>
This is the main SaaS asynchronous micro-service worker entry point. On startup, it will identify implementations of necessary components (such as a queue, data store, and backend worker), and create a WorkerCore object which will handle the logic of data flow between these components. The application class itself here just wrappers this and exposes health checks and metrics.
